validation_scope: All cumulative v1.1.1 CHANGELOG sections after 0.6.5 screened, separate 0.6.6 release checked, commit subjects inventoried, current 17-patch source reconstructed, selected relevant source compared. Not every commit implementation audited. No image build, weight loading, GPU inference or PP/TG comparison.

cumulative_review.earlier_answer_scope: The earlier answer covered 1.1.1 and selected 1.1.0 changes, not the whole cumulative range.

coverage.caveat: Release bullets include held work and known issues, not only shipped changes. Every entry was screened for relevance; relevant entries and selected source paths were examined in detail. This is not a line-by-line audit of every commit.

separate_0_6_6_release.feature: Python CUDA server --name-priority for background aliases
separate_0_6_6_release.note: Separate legacy release; missing from the cumulative 1.1.1 CHANGELOG headings. Native request priority already exists in the current custom source; this release alone is not a throughput improvement.

coverage.commit_count_caveat: Includes merges and branch ancestry; inventoried subjects, not 3174 individually audited implementations.
coverage.current_reconstruction: Downloaded exact db281878 source and successfully applied all 17 local patches in lexical order. Compared selected resulting source paths against exact v1.1.1 source.

candidates.current_status: Absent from reconstructed tokenizer and server
candidates.effect: Avoid repeated CPU tokenization of long chat/tool text; may reduce request preparation/TTFT. Does not itself increase GPU PP/TG. Latest server bounds memo at 64 MiB.
candidates.validation_needed: Token IDs must match fresh encoding, including segment-first handling, special tokens, concurrent use and bounded memory.

candidates.item: Prompt-cache branch retention and turn-history lifetime
candidates.current_status: Current cache has custom repeat_min/seen_keys and shared cuts, but no branched field; old victimBut preferentially evicts extended histories. Latest branch-point/lifetime policy differs.
candidates.decision: Candidate for careful logic backport, not wholesale cache replacement
candidates.effect: Can avoid re-prefill on retries/edits/forks when cache is under pressure; not a demonstrated cold PP or steady-state TG gain.
candidates.validation_needed: Retain current FP8/1M family snapshots, custom repeated-prompt policy and memory accounting; compare resumed-token counts and cache-off-equivalent output.

candidates.current_status: Absent from current server/listener.zig; rank transport socket tuning is separate.
candidates.effect: Streaming transport latency; no demonstrated GPU throughput gain.

candidates.item: Pre-token SSE keepalive and graceful draining
candidates.current_status: No TF_SSE_KEEPALIVE_S or TF_DRAIN_S in reconstructed source
candidates.effect: Connection stability and controlled shutdown, not GPU PP/TG.

candidates.item: Request-owned queue/decode/elapsed timing and seed logs
candidates.current_status: Current Talk already separates PP/TG; newer per-request logging is an observability candidate.
candidates.decision: Keep selected backport candidate without redefining current speed metrics
candidates.effect: Diagnosis and attribution, not measured acceleration.

candidates.current_status: Current FlashNext uses custom ModelOpt kernels; the cited --precision checkpoint/full result is for Super VL/Nemotron, not this model.
candidates.decision: Separate development/benchmark candidate; not a safe automatic backport or proof of current-model speedup.
candidates.effect: Possible GPU prefill acceleration requires adapting exact mixed-format layers and validating quality; activation math changes. Published decode in that example is slower in checkpoint mode.
candidates.validation_needed: Matched Talk sampler/context/MTP, PP/TG/TTFT and output-quality comparison on this exact checkpoint; retain baseline.

candidates.current_status: Current FlashNext source does not call add_rms_h; current routed-expert prompt path uses custom fn_experts_prompt/fn_experts_tile kernels.
candidates.decision: Research references only; no direct same-operator drop-in or proven gain.

candidates.decision: Remove from current-model priority candidates; generic correctness/performance option only.

candidates.decision: Do not transfer their speed claims to the running model.
